result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge, and lower restaurant content is obstructed by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off at the right edge: an unlabeled partial category pill is visible after “Healthy,” making the row look accidentally cropped rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clear horizontal-scroll affordance and sufficient right-side padding, or resize/space category chips so the visible viewport ends cleanly.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel is clipped on the right: the third card’s image, restaurant name (“Trattoria Picco…”), and delivery price are truncated by the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Use an intentional peek-card carousel treatment with consistent card width and right inset, or ensure cards/labels fit within the viewport without awkward text clipping.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next “Popular right now” restaurant card, hiding a substantial portion of its image and any content below it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation height (plus safe-area inset) so all feed cards can scroll fully above the bottom bar.
